sources.title: xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google publishes compressed-tensors W4A16 QAT checkpoints for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B. Its QAT model card lists none for 26B-A4B, which ships as Q4_0 GGUF and as a 48 GiB bf16 export.

sources.snippet: At the time of release, this family of models provides high-performance open vision-language model implementations designed from the ground up for responsible AI development compared to similarly sized models.

sources.title: devto-gemma4-26b-qat-w4a16-v6e1.md - GitHub
sources.snippet: The output is published as xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct, so Steps 2 and 3 can be skipped by downloading it. It writes compressed-tensors pack-quantized symmetric int4 with group size 32, the format of Google's other QAT releases.

sources.title: gemma4:e4b-it-qat
sources.snippet: Readme Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input and generating text output. Gemma 4 introduces key capability and architectural advancements: Reasoning - All models in the family are designed as highly capable reasoners, with configurable thinking modes.

sources.title: gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-w4a16-ct · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Unquantized QAT checkpoints (Q4_0): Half-precision weights extracted from the QAT pipeline, ideal for custom downstream compilation and research. Available for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B, and their drafter models.
